name: GET /api/admin/auth/me - Current platform admin identity
description: Returns the authenticated platform administrator's identity and whether their session has completed step-up verification. Guarded by authenticateToken + requirePlatformAdmin applied at the router level.

errorCases.when: The caller is authenticated but is not a platform_admin (a tenant-level admin is refused here)

errorCases.message: Platform administrator access has been revoked
errorCases.when: The admin's own access_status is suspended or revoked
